format: Non-WSDC contests at a WSDC Registry Event (opt-out disclosure)

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: For non-WSDC contests, a Registry Event must publish if and for which contests it opts not to use the Callback and/or Relative Placement scoring systems.

requirement: The opt-out requires contest-level identification of a non-WSDC contest plus a published disclosure naming the contest, and never applies to a WSDC Jack and Jill contest. Not implemented: DanceFlow has no contest-level identification or disclosure record and this slice adds no SQL, so WSDC-declared events stay blocked (WSDC_NON_WSDC_CONTEST_OPT_OUT.implemented = false).
enforcement_point: Server actions approveRoundResultAction and publishRoundResultAction call guardRoundResultsForSanction before the database transition and refuse when blocked; the round results page and publicationControls mirror the refusal. App layer only: the database RPCs do not check the declaration (follow-up, needs SQL).

tests.name: OD-01 guard: every body x method x declaration combination

interpretation_notes: Follow-up needs SQL and an owner-gated apply: contest-level non-WSDC identification, a published opt-out disclosure record per contest, and a hard refusal for any Jack and Jill contest type. effective_from is the file-name revision date (Jan 17 2026), not a stated effective date. Until then the exception is documented, not usable. Terminology: Registry Event (not 'sanctioned event').
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
